title: Switch default background to landscape.jpg (both themes) with brand accent #2ed8b0
description:
Replace the shipped default wallpaper. Currently light/dark modes each use a different topo image (img/topo-light.webp, img/topo-dark.webp) as --default-bg-image. Switch both themes to the single new img/landscape.jpg asset (already added at /home/russell/Documents/Meridian/img/landscape.jpg, mirroring the mountain/gradient-sky screenshot shared in chat 99df29a9), and keep the accent locked to brand #2ed8b0 in both themes (do not let the wallpaper solver derive/tint the accent from this image — same "shipped wallpaper is brand-locked" behavior documented in meridian.css around line 44-76).

Scope:
1. meridian.css (root project) — update --default-bg-image in :root, the prefers-color-scheme: dark block, and html[data-theme="dark"] block to all point at img/landscape.jpg instead of topo-light.webp / topo-dark.webp.
2. meridian-extension/meridian.css — same change, mirrored.
3. Copy img/landscape.jpg into meridian-extension/img/ (extension currently only has topo-light.webp/topo-dark.webp; needs the new asset alongside).
4. Confirm the wallpaper solver (components/SettingsPanel.js / meridian-extension/components/SettingsPanel.js, applyDerivedAccent) still treats this as the "shipped default" case that does NOT tint --accent-hue/--accent-sat from the image — accent should stay hardcoded brand hue 166/69% (i.e. #2ed8b0-derived) in both light and dark, per the existing comment block in meridian.css. If the solver identifies "shipped wallpaper" by filename/URL rather than a flag, update that detection so it still matches the new landscape.jpg default (do not just skip solving entirely — the flag mechanism should be filename-agnostic if reasonably easy, else update the literal path check).
5. Leave topo-light.webp/topo-dark.webp/topo.svg files in place (unused default, but may still be referenced elsewhere, e.g. as a selectable preset) — do not delete unless you confirm nothing else references them as an option.
6. Sanity check the extension's manifest/web_accessible_resources (if any) lists img/*.jpg or a glob that already covers the new file; add landscape.jpg explicitly if the manifest enumerates files rather than globbing.

Context: this default is primarily being tuned for the Chrome Web Store listing screenshot appeal — reference chat 99df29a9 for the visual discussion (light vs dark mode comparison, why dark mode/this background was chosen).
label: Feature

activity.content:
Implemented the landscape wallpaper default in both runtime trees.

- All light, system-dark, and explicit-dark `--default-bg-image` declarations now use `img/landscape.jpg`.
- Added the byte-identical landscape asset to `meridian-extension/img/landscape.jpg`.
- Confirmed the brand lock is filename-agnostic: the shipped default is recognized by its semantic theme token and clears derived accent overrides, preserving hue 166 / saturation 69% with theme-specific lightness. Added regression assertions for this behavior.
- Kept all existing topo assets untouched.
- Confirmed neither manifest enumerates `web_accessible_resources`, so no manifest change is required for this extension-owned CSS asset.
- Validation: `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` passed all 156 tests; `git diff --check` and source/package parity checks passed.
